cause: Default pathlib ordering is case-insensitive on Windows and case-sensitive on Linux. SCHEDULE_CONTEXT_LIMITATION_NOTE.md therefore moved from last to first in the regenerated experiment inventory. Source report bytes and metrics did not differ.
remediation: Use an explicit (filename.casefold(), filename) sort key and test both POSIX and Windows path semantics plus mixed-case index construction. Preserve the committed inventory and Markdown index without regeneration.
verification_scope: This records the failed CI attempt, not a successful rerun. Follow-up source and distribution validation records and the subsequent GitHub workflow retain their own outcomes.
